whenToUse: Re-authenticating over the running app after an idle timeout without losing unsaved work.
Offering password or passkey to continue, plus a switch-account escape hatch.
avoidWhen: A first sign-in from scratch — use login-01.
Picking a workspace after sign-in — use select-workspace-01.
a11y: The dialog is labelled with aria-labelledby; because it cannot be dismissed, make the continue and switch-account actions obvious and keyboard reachable.
Visually hidden text gives context to icon-only controls.
